label: prf:categorical-hodge-star-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of the categorical Hodge star
html: The defining identity \alpha \wedge \star \beta = \int_A(\alpha^* \cdot \beta) \mathrm{vol} must hold for every \alpha \in \Omega^k(A). By non-degeneracy of the wedge pairing \Omega^k \otimes \Omega^{n-k} \to \Omega^n \xrightarrow{\int_A} \mathbf{1}, \star \beta is uniquely determined as the element of \Omega^{n-k}(A) representing the linear functional \alpha \mapsto \int_A(\alpha^* \cdot \beta) \mathrm{vol}. Hence any two candidates for \star agree on every \beta, so \star_1 = \star_2.
heading: Proof
